assessment: This paper will be of interest to immunologists who study T cell recognition and informaticians who predict peptide ligands for MHC. It rigorously innovates a high-throughput approach to identify MHC ligands of pathogens on the proteome level using a previously developed yeast display-based platform, including ligands not identified by computational prediction. The data support the conclusions well and open a direction for future work to address the immunological significance of the findings.
